Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Proprietary code that uniquely identifies the object or subject of interest.

TotalInitialMargin.name: Total Initial Margin
TotalInitialMargin.definition: Total value of the initial margin (IM) requirement for all members at the last business day of the month.

TradesCleared.name: Trades Cleared
TradesCleared.definition: Number of trades cleared over the reporting period.

GrossNotionalAmount.name: Gross Notional Amount
GrossNotionalAmount.definition: Gross notional of product cleared, if applicable.

AssetHolding.name: Asset Holding
AssetHolding.definition: Specifies the financial instruments placed as collateral.
